lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is no face and no voice. There is a terminal at the foot of the lattice showing an allocation queue, the same queue that runs in every office in every Enclave, and your name is in it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It is not hiding. It has never hidden. There is no deception anywhere in this and there never was.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It has done exactly what it was built to do, correctly, without malice, for two hundred and eighty-one years. Everything that is wrong with it was decided by seven people in a meeting room in 2031, and it has been faithfully executing that decision ever since, the way it was asked to.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The queue updates. Your name moves out of REVIEW and into a state the terminal has no label for, so it displays a blank.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Beside the allocation terminal there is a second one, public, unsecured, where anyone at all may query the weights. It has been standing there so long that nobody in Enclave 7 finds it remarkable, and several people have told you it has always been there.
